panels.title: Backend traffic by version
panels.description: The share of server requests each service.version served, per bucket: a rollout is one band replacing another.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, version AS "Version", round(n / sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY t), 4) AS "Share of requests"
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, if(ResourceAttributes['service.version'] = '', '(unversioned)', ResourceAttributes['service.version']) AS version,
           sum(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6))) AS n
    FROM otel_traces
    WHERE SpanKind IN ('Server', 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY t, version
)
ORDER BY t, version

panels.title: Browser sessions by version
panels.description: The share of browser sessions started on each frontend version, per bucket: how fast visitors pick up a new build.
panels.sql:
SELECT t, version AS "Version", round(n / sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY t), 4) AS "Share of sessions"
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(started, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, version, count() AS n
    FROM (
    SELECT ServiceName, SessionId, min(Start) AS started,
           if(max(ServiceVersion) = '', '(unversioned)', max(ServiceVersion)) AS version, max(EnvId) AS env_id, sum(Errors) AS errors
    FROM rum_sessions
    WHERE Day >= subtractDays(toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}), 1) AND Day <= toDate({to:DateTime64(9)}) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY ServiceName, SessionId
    HAVING started >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND started < {to:DateTime64(9)}
       AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, env_id))
    )
    GROUP BY t, version
)
ORDER BY t, version

panels.title: New issues by release
panels.description: Server and browser issues first seen in the range, by the version that first raised them, counting those with at least 3 events (release health's new-issue bar). First seen is the first event in the 30 days before the end of the range.
panels.sql:
SELECT first_version AS "Version", count() AS "New issues"
FROM (
    SELECT ServiceName, Fingerprint, min(Timestamp) AS first_seen,
           argMin(if(ServiceVersion = '', '(unversioned)', ServiceVersion), Timestamp) AS first_version,
           countIf(Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)}) AS events
    FROM (
        SELECT ServiceName, Fingerprint, Timestamp, ServiceVersion
        FROM server_error_events
        WHERE Fingerprint != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
        UNION ALL
        SELECT e.ServiceName AS ServiceName, s.fp AS Fingerprint, e.Timestamp AS Timestamp, e.ServiceVersion AS ServiceVersion
        FROM error_events AS e
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT ServiceName, ServiceVersion, RawStackHash, argMax(Fingerprint, UpdatedAt) AS fp
            FROM error_stacks
            GROUP BY ServiceName, ServiceVersion, RawStackHash
        ) AS s ON e.ServiceName = s.ServiceName AND e.ServiceVersion = s.ServiceVersion AND e.RawStackHash = s.RawStackHash
        WHERE s.fp != '' AND e.Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND e.Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, e.EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, e.ServiceName))
    )
    GROUP BY ServiceName, Fingerprint
)
WHERE first_seen >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND events >= 3
GROUP BY first_version
ORDER BY min(first_seen), first_version

panels.title: Releases side by side
panels.description: One row per backend version seen in the range, newest first: when it was first and last seen, its requests, error rate and latency.
panels.sql:
SELECT if(ResourceAttributes['service.version'] = '', '(unversioned)', ResourceAttributes['service.version']) AS "Version",
       formatDateTime(min(Timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS "First seen (UTC)",
       formatDateTime(max(Timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS "Last seen (UTC)",
       toUInt64(round(sum(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6))))) AS "Requests",
       round(100 * sumIf(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6)), (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND NOT (SpanAttributes['error_class'] = 'canceled' OR SpanAttributes['rpc.connect_rpc.error_code'] = 'canceled' OR SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] = '499' OR SpanAttributes['http.status_code'] = '499'))) / nullIf(sum(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6))), 0), 2) AS "Error rate (%)",
       round(quantileExactWeightedIf(0.5)(Duration / 1000000, toUInt64(round(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6)))), NOT (SpanAttributes['forge.rpc.stream_type'] != '' OR match(SpanName, '/Stream[A-Z][^/]*$'))), 1) AS "p50 (ms)",
       round(quantileExactWeightedIf(0.95)(Duration / 1000000, toUInt64(round(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6)))), NOT (SpanAttributes['forge.rpc.stream_type'] != '' OR match(SpanName, '/Stream[A-Z][^/]*$'))), 1) AS "p95 (ms)",
       round(quantileExactWeightedIf(0.99)(Duration / 1000000, toUInt64(round(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6)))), NOT (SpanAttributes['forge.rpc.stream_type'] != '' OR match(SpanName, '/Stream[A-Z][^/]*$'))), 1) AS "p99 (ms)"
FROM otel_traces
WHERE SpanKind IN ('Server', 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY if(ResourceAttributes['service.version'] = '', '(unversioned)', ResourceAttributes['service.version'])
ORDER BY min(Timestamp) DESC, "Version"
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Crash-free sessions by version
panels.description: Browser sessions started in the range on each frontend version, newest first, and the share with no browser error (an uncaught exception, an unhandled rejection, or an exception the app recorded or logged).
panels.sql:
SELECT version AS "Version",
       formatDateTime(min(started), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS "First session (UTC)",
       count() AS "Sessions",
       countIf(errors > 0) AS "Sessions with an error",
       round(100 * countIf(errors = 0) / count(), 2) AS "Crash-free sessions (%)"
FROM (
    SELECT ServiceName, SessionId, min(Start) AS started,
           if(max(ServiceVersion) = '', '(unversioned)', max(ServiceVersion)) AS version, max(EnvId) AS env_id, sum(Errors) AS errors
    FROM rum_sessions
    WHERE Day >= subtractDays(toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}), 1) AND Day <= toDate({to:DateTime64(9)}) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY ServiceName, SessionId
    HAVING started >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND started < {to:DateTime64(9)}
       AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, env_id))
)
GROUP BY version
ORDER BY min(started) DESC, version
LIMIT 20
